description: This file defines the AxisTouchButton class which manages touch input buttons that control axis values for cross-platform input handling in Unity. It handles pairing with another button, creating or referencing a virtual axis, and updating axis values on pointer events.

classes.name: AxisTouchButton
classes.description: A MonoBehaviour that responds to pointer events to simulate axis input via touch buttons, allowing pairing with another button and updating a virtual axis accordingly.

methods.name: OnEnable
methods.description: Initializes the virtual axis when the object is enabled, creating a new axis if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: FindPairedButton
methods.description: Finds and assigns the paired AxisTouchButton with the same axis name for coordinated input handling.

methods.name: OnDisable
methods.description: Removes the virtual axis from the input system when the object is disabled.

methods.name: OnPointerDown
methods.description: Updates the axis value to the specified axisValue when the button is pressed.

methods.name: OnPointerUp
methods.description: Resets the axis value to zero when the button is released.
